intents_zh: 多 cluster 套同一份 manifest
code:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: ApplicationSet
metadata:
  name: {{set_name}}
spec:
  generators:
    - list:
        elements:
          - env: dev
          - env: staging
          - env: prod
  template:
    metadata:
      name: '{{set_name}}-{{`{{env}}`}}'
    spec:
      project: default
      source:
        repoURL: {{repo_url}}
        path: 'overlays/{{`{{env}}`}}'
      destination:
        server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
        namespace: '{{`{{env}}`}}'
summary_zh: ApplicationSet 一份 spec 展開多環境
